parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The action mode of the rule. Valid values:

*   **1**: alerts
*   **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

*   **0**: user-defined rule
*   **1**: built-in rule

parameters.name: WhiteImages
parameters.description: The images that are added to the whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-container-plugin-rule --lang zh --rule-id 100012 --biz-mode 1 --rule-name test --selected-policy ssh_user_publickey_config --rule-type 0 --white-images centos --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyContainerPluginRule --region cn-hangzhou --WhiteImages.1 centos --RuleId 100012 --Mode 1 --Lang zh --SelectedPolicy.1 ssh_user_publickey_config --RuleType 0 --RuleName test
